title: Halo
author: Charles Stross
note: conf=0.9; EPUB metadata fields are swapped (title field holds author + shelving label; author field holds the title). "Lobsters 04" is not a published series; it is a fan-made label derived from the first story of the sequence. The canonical series per ISFDB is "Macx Family," in which Halo is #4 (Lobsters, Troubadour, Tourist, Halo, Router, Nightfall, Curator, Elector, Survivor). The nine stories were later combined into the fix-up novel Accelerando (2005); Macx Family is the tighter/verified series designation. Halo first appeared in Asimov's SF, June 2002 (Hugo and Sturgeon nominee); the 2011 date in the filename reflects an ebook repackaging, not first publication. No ISBN for the standalone novelette.
